status: Documentary transcription for review; not a production correctionlib payload or a complete nuisance prescription.

source.title: High pT muons
source.speaker: L. Thomas, on behalf of EXO-25-021
source.method: Text extracted from each 2024 panel, checked cell by cell against PDF coordinates and visually against rendered tables. Step-2 repetition across phi verified exactly.

momentum: TuneP pt, explicitly stated on PDF page 9.
units: TeV^-1 for additive curvature bias; shown on fit axes on page 10. Multiply by 0.001 for GeV^-1.
bin_edge_provenance: Read from the plotted histogram geometry and axes; the page-10 examples explicitly identify 0.8<eta<1.2, 2.1<eta<2.4, and pi/3 phi bins. The deck does not define numerical edge-inclusion conventions.
precision: Values and errors retain the three decimal places printed in the slides. This is not a recovery of the full-precision fit output.

step1_phi_modulation.array_order: Rows are increasing phi from -pi to pi (bottom to top in the plot); columns are increasing signed eta.
step1_phi_modulation.derivation: Single-muon data versus a data template averaged over phi and mirrored eta; HLT_Mu50, exactly one highPtId muon, pfIsoId>=5, TuneP pt>200 GeV.
step1_phi_modulation.nominal_application_evidence: Page 17 explicitly applies this step to data TuneP and compares with nominal TuneP; pages 18-20 show validation.

step2_eta_residual.array_order: Increasing signed eta; ten unique parameters, repeated over all six phi rows in the source figure.
step2_eta_residual.derivation: Dimuon data versus MC after step 1. MC template includes DY, diboson and ttbar. Page 14 prints a tracker-isolation inequality inconsistent with the preceding isolation description; do not copy it as a selection prescription.
step2_eta_residual.nominal_application_limit: Described as a further correction on page 9, but the displayed validation on page 17 explicitly uses step 1 only. Confirm the adopted two-step prescription before production.

bias_convention.definition: The illustration on page 9 defines injected bias by (q/pt)_biased = (q/pt)_reference + kappa_b.
bias_convention.formula_status: Algebraic inverse of the stated bias definition, not a supplied implementation. Match the sign convention of any eventual machine-readable map or helper.
bias_convention.two_stage_algebra: If both maps are adopted as biases to remove, sequential curvature subtractions use kappa_b = kappa_phi + kappa_eta. This identity does not determine their covariance or establish the final recommended nominal combination.

uncertainty_limit: The deck prints uncertainties but supplies no complete stat/syst breakdown, inter-bin or inter-stage covariance, or final nuisance implementation. Do not assume all cells and both steps are independent.

2024_resolution.statement: EXO-25-021 reports extra 15% MC smearing based on boosted-Z width comparisons, described as a strategy blessed by MUO POG for 2024.
2024_resolution.scope_limit: This is evidence for the analysis-specific strategy. The deck does not provide a standalone 2024 sigma(pt,eta) function or a complete prescription for the current PF-isolated ordinary-momentum selection.
2024_resolution.interpretation: It is not a 15% shift of every muon pt. If a 15% increase of resolution width is implemented through independent Gaussian smearing, sigma_extra=sqrt(1.15**2-1)*sigma_MC=0.56789083458*sigma_MC.
2024_resolution.GE_interplay: Page 19 shows that bias removal narrows the high-eta Z peak. Assess the residual MC smearing after the adopted data-side GE treatment; the earlier 15% benchmark is not automatically unchanged.
